newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans rise after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans rise after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was mainly lower in slow trade midsession at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with harvest supply and a shortage of storage space weighing on prices, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Bahia Blanca, Quequen and Rosario lost $2 to $113. FAS elevator soybeans rose $2 in Rosario to $312 in moderate volume trade, with tight supply and crushers keen to buy. Sunflower seed was mainly firmer, rising $3 in Bahia Blanca to $225 in good volume. Crushers are buying well to meet oil committments. Wheat rose $2 in Buenos Aires to $180, with millers buying.
